prompt.project_info: Photorealistic lifestyle portrait in a public library aisle.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved young adult woman with long wavy light-brown hair and blonde highlights, playful pout, eyes looking upward-left, wearing a fitted beige crop top and blue denim jeans; holding 3-4 colorful hardcover books and carrying a cream canvas tote.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium shot, subject slightly angled and centered between tall beige bookshelves; books, varied spines, call-number stickers, high ceiling, fluorescent tube, and industrial beams remain visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright cool-toned diffused fluorescent interior light, clear face with minimal shadows, casual academic playful bookworm mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K/Ultra HD lifestyle photography, sharp face and books, slightly shallow depth of field, detailed denim, paper, and hair textures.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical photorealistic lifestyle portrait of one generic approved young adult woman with long wavy balayage hair, beige crop top, blue jeans, playful pout, holding colorful library books and wearing a cream tote, standing in a bright public library aisle between packed bookshelves; cool fluorescent light, crisp face and books, softly softened background.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed books or hands, unreadable added text, watermark, logo overlay
